notes: Reviewed all 145 auto-actions touching my 22 books: approved 101 junk removals; amended/vetoed 44 (every auto-move and move-chapter carried an unreliable token-score target such as physical-chemistry, photography or foundation-biology; six removals were numeric/token false positives - LM723, the 555 timer, the LM317, TIA cascoding, 'Three Elements Specified', the z-ROC, the EM wave equation). Adjudicated all 50 misAdjudicate items (12 moves, 7 removes, 31 keeps), all 36 junkSuspects (pastes and page-number mashes -> remove), 4 dupe clusters and 3 thin chapters (all keep - intro/synthesis chapters are conventionally light). Free scan added 57 extra findings: the Drive-PDF pollution concentrated as a six-lesson low-noise cluster in analog-and-digital-communication ch1 (consolidated into analog-electronics ch1), a data-converter cluster in power-electronics ch1 (moved to analog-electronics ch9), syllabus-soup pastes (removed as covered by their owning books) and page-number TOC mashes (removed). All 22 books' chapter order is pedagogically sound - no reorder flags. No moves into/out of the four exempt authored math books; every move target verified in the legend.
